status: exploratory protocol fixed before this calculation; not a prospective preregistration
estimand: median(selected high-energy event times) minus median(selected low-energy event times)
scope: Descriptive selected-event contrast, not intrinsic spectral lag, source-only timing, propagation speed or a GR/LIV bound
bootstrap_assumption: Within each band and fixed window, event times are independent draws from the conditional selected-event time distribution. Background, response and intrinsic emission are not propagated by this bootstrap.
